text: The pump controller shall stop the pump within 200 ms of a stop command.
The pump controller shall stop the pump quickly when the operator presses the stop button.
The pump shall not run dry.
The pump controller shall log every start and stop event with a timestamp.
The flow rate shall be displayed on the operator panel.
The pump controller shall support Modbus TCP and/or CAN.
The pump controller shall report faults, warnings, etc. to the SCADA system.
The operator panel should be easy to use.
The pump controller shall minimize energy consumption.
The pump controller shall restart the pump automatically if possible.
The pressure sensor shall send its reading to the controller every 100 ms.
The pump controller shall keep the outlet pressure between 2.0 bar and 2.5 bar.
The pump controller shall stop the pump within 500 ms of a stop command.
The battery backup shall power the controller for at least one hour.
The pump controller shall raise an alarm when the inlet pressure drops below 0.5 bar. The pump controller shall stop the pump at the same time.
